headword: {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}

definitions.gloss: lodging facilities; accommodation; place to stay
definitions.explanation: Any facility that provides overnight accommodation for guests, including hotels, ryokan, hostels, minshuku, and other types of lodging.

examples.japanese: {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are few lodging facilities in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{観光客|かんこうきゃく}→観光客：03022_kankoukyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{増加|ぞうか}→増加：03329_zouka⟧⟦に{伴|ともな}い→に伴い：06804_nitomonai⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: With the increase in tourists, new lodging facilities are being built one after another.

notes:
USAGE:
A general term encompassing all types of lodging. Common in tourism, government, and business contexts. Japan offers diverse accommodation types including ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧ (hotel), ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧ (traditional Japanese inn), ⟦{民宿|みんしゅく}→民宿：08165_minshuku⟧ (guesthouse), ⟦ペンション→ペンション：15998_penshon⟧ (pension), and ⟦カプセルホテル→カプセルホテル：27577_kapuseruhoteru⟧ (capsule hotel).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧ (to look for lodging)
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧ (to book accommodation)
- {宿泊施設|しゅくはくしせつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧ (securing accommodation)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{宿|やど}→宿：03641_yado⟧: lodging, inn — a simpler, more everyday word
- ⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧: traditional Japanese inn — a specific type of accommodation
